Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Harish Bhandari. I am a 63-year-old farmer living in Coimbatore. Sujata More has filed a police complaint against me over ₹64,40,000, and the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 06544618367 or email harish.bhandari@example.in.
